author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video and discover how Unreal Engine 5 helped Bit Reactor bring a galaxy of tactical possibilities to life, empowering the studio with the tools to build their debut project ‘Star Wars Zero Company,’ a gritty, authentic Star Wars™ story set in the Clone Wars era. 

The game sees you deploy a team of operatives with a wide variety of archetypes—from scoundrels to astromechs, or even a Jedi—in a single-player, turn-based tactics story developed in collaboration with Electronic Arts, Respawn Entertainment, and Lucasfilm Games.

Check out the interview to find out how Unreal Engine features such as Lumen, Nanite, and MetaHuman helped Bit Reactor Technical Director Ryan McFall’s team realize their vision.

Read the full interview here: https://epic.gm/dev-interviews-star-wars-zero-company
